sources.excerpt: Belle Overdrive | Wampler Pedals Home Shop All Pedals Distortion / Overdrive Compression Fuzz Delay / Reverb Modulation Boost & Utilities Discontinued Plugins Merchandise Dealers Community Blog Artists Podcast Videos Support About Downloads FAQs Warranty Registration Withdrawal Request Contact Us search account_circle My Account search Products search Belle Overdrive With the Belle, Brian Wampler has taken a classic low gain overdrive circuit and tweaked it to perfection… In stock Belle Overdrive quantity Add to cart Watch video Overview Features Videos Technical Downloads In stock Belle Overdrive quantity Add to cart “The Belle has a nice, full body yet stays crunchy and crispy in milk.” Right facing | Front | Left facing | Back | Top |' data-navmenu="off" data-hashurl="off" data-menuSlider="off" data-continue-autoplay="off" data-outside-nav="off" data-autoplay="off" > 4 5 The pedal that inspired this circuit has been around for a long time in various forms but most versions of it have too much of a “Hi Fi” sound about them, they fail to get the right mix of clarity and bass that is needed to make this overdrive sing. Brian has added further gain capabilities to this circuit, and added a bass control that controls all the harmonics from smooth and creamy to tight and crunchy. The sound this circuit delivers is a firm favorite in Nashville and Brian Wampler’s take is everything you would expect it to be – high quality components, a beautiful enclosure, and a glorious tone. If you set the gain low and the bass control up high, you get a wonderful clean boost sound that can rival any Klone circuit, but when you spin the bass down and the gain all the way up, you suddenly find yourself with an awesome transparent overdrive / medium distortion sound with all the crunch you need. The Color control is more than just a standard tone control and it’s pretty unique to this circuit. Dialling it right or left will either boost or cut the high and low end a little, but the midrange frequencies are left well alone. Combine this with the Bass control and you have a very versatile tone shaping palette with Wampler’s legendary ease of use. Brian has also added a push switch on the side which will control the amount of compression and alter the clipping structure in the circuit for some extra punch. sources.excerpt: Wampler Pedals Belle Overdrive | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Wampler Pedals Belle Overdrive Belle Overdrive The Wampler Belle Overdrive is a versatile overdrive pedal designed to deliver a range of tones, from clean boosts to crunchy overdrives and medium distortion. It offers a unique bass control and a 'Color' control for tone shaping, along with a side-mounted compression switch. The pedal is designed for flexibility, and is great when combined with other pedals like a Klon circuit or other overdrives to further refine your sound. What Wampler Pedals say about the Belle Overdrive The pedal that inspired this circuit has been around for a long time in various forms but most versions of it have too much of a “Hi Fi” sound about them, they fail to get the right mix of clarity and bass that is needed to make this overdrive sing. Brian has added further gain capabilities to this circuit, and added a bass control that controls all the harmonics from smooth and creamy to tight and crunchy. The sound this circuit delivers is a firm favorite in Nashville and Brian Wampler’s take is everything you would expect it to be – high quality components, a beautiful enclosure, and a glorious tone. If you set the gain low and the bass control up high, you get a wonderful clean boost sound that can rival any Klone circuit, but when you spin the bass down and the gain all the way up, you suddenly find yourself with an awesome transparent overdrive / medium distortion sound with all the crunch you need. The Color control is more than just a standard tone control and it’s pretty unique to this circuit. Dialling it right or left will either boost or cut the high and low end a little, but the midrange frequencies are left well alone. Combine this with the Bass control and you have a very versatile tone shaping palette with Wampler’s legendary ease of use. Brian has also added a push switch on the side which will control the amount of compression and alter the clipping structure in the circuit for some extra punch. This pedal can add some serious muscle to your country, some extra grit to your blues, and some soaring boosts to rock – it’s such a flexible drive we know you are going to love stacking it with your favorite pedals as much as playing it straight through a clean amp. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists praised the Wampler Belle Overdrive for its exceptional tone and versatility. Many users found it superior to other overdrive pedals they had owned, including [Nobels] and [King of Tone]. They particularly appreciated its ability to work well in live settings and its compatibility with various guitars and amplifiers. Reviewers loved how the pedal could be used with other drive pedals such as a [Tumnus] or boost an already dirty amp.
